description: Golden vectors for tax calculation calc_v 1 (tax/README.md). Every implementation (client-core/tax in TypeScript, svc-billing in Go) must reproduce every expected value to the paisa. Amounts are paise, quantities thousandths, rates basis points. A case with ca_confirm true encodes a rule that needs CA confirmation (see note); the vector pins the provisional behaviour so a change is deliberate.

cases.title: Single 5% line, exclusive
cases.note: CGST = SGST = round half up of taxable x 250 / 10000.

cases.title: Half-paisa CGST rounds half up (937.5 to 938)
cases.note: Each component rounded separately, half up.

cases.title: CGST fraction .25 rounds down
CGST fraction .75 rounds up
CGST fraction exactly .5 rounds up
18 percent rate (specified premises rule set)
cases.note: The rate comes from the rule set row selected by the premises flag, never from code.

cases.title: Tax per group, not per line (three lines of 333)
cases.note: Per line the tax would be 8 + 8 + 8 per component; per group it is 25. RM-B4.

cases.title: Standard and non-GST items
cases.note: Non-GST lines carry no tax and are shown apart. CA to confirm liquor treatment in Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

cases.title: Exempt class shows a zero-tax group
Three groups in one bill
Fractional quantity (1.5 units)
cases.note: Weighed goods: quantities are thousandths.

cases.title: Line value rounds half up (1.250 x 333)
cases.note: 416.25 rounds to 416.

cases.title: Line value rounds half up (1.500 x 333)
cases.note: 499.5 rounds to 500.

cases.title: Modifier delta added to the unit price
Negative modifier delta clamps the unit at zero
cases.note: The line total never goes below zero (RM-M3).

cases.title: Zero-total bill
cases.note: A zero-total bill carries no tax.

cases.title: Line discount 10 percent
cases.note: Discounts apply before tax.

cases.title: Line percent discount rounds half up (100.5 to 101)
Line amount discount
Line discount larger than the line is refused
cases.note: RM-B8.

cases.title: Bill discount 10 percent allocated by largest remainder
cases.note: Allocation sums exactly to the discount (RM-B2).

cases.title: Bill amount discount with remainder to the largest fraction
Remainder ties go to the earlier line
Bill discount larger than the net is refused
100 percent bill discount leaves zero tax
cases.note: RM-D3: treated as a comp of every line.

cases.title: Line discount and bill discount together
Complimentary line among paid lines
cases.note: A comp line prints at zero, keeps its list value and carries no tax. CA to confirm GST on free supplies.

cases.title: Bill of complimentary lines only
cases.note: CA to confirm whether a fully complimentary bill takes a number (founder default R2-Q22: close as internal; Settle zero invoice numbers it).

cases.title: Service charge 10 percent on one group
cases.note: Charge on the discounted total, taxed at its group rate. CA to confirm tax on service charge.

cases.title: Service charge across a standard and a non-GST group
cases.note: Allocated pro rata by group value; the non-GST share is untaxed. CA to confirm.

cases.title: Service charge on the discounted total
cases.note: Order: discount, then service charge on the result, then tax. CA to confirm tax on service charge.

cases.title: Service charge remainder across three groups
cases.note: Largest remainder across groups; ties by tax class order. CA to confirm tax on service charge.

cases.title: Packing charge in its own tax class
cases.note: Packing taxed at the class chosen for it (default fnb_standard); ADR-0014 leaves the allocation rule for packing open, so this is provisional. CA to confirm.

cases.title: Inclusive 10500 at 5 percent
cases.note: RM-B5: taxable = gross x 10000 / (10000 + rate).

cases.title: Inclusive 11800 at 18 percent
Inclusive: taxable plus tax differs from the gross by a paisa
cases.note: The difference goes to the round-off line; the guest pays the menu price. CA to confirm.

cases.title: Inclusive: another paisa difference
cases.note: CA to confirm.

Inclusive with discount, service charge and a non-GST line
cases.note: CA to confirm.

cases.title: Round-off down (pre-round 10449)
cases.note: Rounded half up to the nearest rupee as a separate signed line; never part of the tax base. CA to confirm.

cases.title: Round-off at exactly 50 paise rounds up
cases.note: CA to confirm.

cases.title: Round-off switched off keeps the paise
Composition regime: no tax
cases.note: Bill of supply, tax zero and not shown (RM-T5). CA to confirm what a composition dealer issues.

cases.title: Unregistered regime: no tax
cases.note: Plain bill (RM-T5).

cases.title: ECO (aggregator) channel rule
cases.note: The rule row for channel eco may carry no GST (Section 9(5) is reported by the aggregator). Document form and rate are CA-pending; the vector only proves the engine follows the rule row.

cases.note: The discount reduces the gross; tax is extracted from the discounted gross.

cases.title: Credit note: full reversal reproduces the bill totals
cases.note: A full credit note equals the bill to the paisa, round-off included.

cases.title: Credit note: partial quantity
cases.note: RM-B10: credited value is the line value after discounts, prorated by quantity, half up.

cases.title: Credit note: partial with the bill discount share prorated
cases.note: The original bill's discount share travels with the credited quantity.

cases.title: Credit note: partial with service charge
cases.note: The group's charge share is prorated with the credited value. CA to confirm tax on service charge.

Credit note: one unit of three; the parts of a bill may differ from it by rounding
cases.note: The sum of the credit notes of a bill can differ from the bill by a paisa of rounding; the document register and the verification accept a difference within the rounding of one rupee per tax group (RM-B9). CA to confirm.
